Author: Arkfrost
Name: TeleportMap
Punchline: A visual map overlay with clickable teleport locations.
Description:
Tired of searching through lists of text to teleport? 
    Are you the visual type as well who likes maps?
    TeleportMap is a grid based map overlay, that shows you a network of teleport locations, for those who want to go somewhere in two keypresses
    Open the overlay with /tpmap
    Pressing Esc closes the map at any time.
